classificacao.explanation: Based on the experiments described, a European catfish weighing around 35-45 kg could exert enough force in water to pull a human underwater. The narrator's own experience with a 74 kg catfish (which was more than half his body weight) demonstrated that even larger individuals can overpower a human, but the critical threshold for initiating an attack appears to be in the 35-45 kg range. This is due to the reduced effective weight of a human in water (about 1/7 of their body weight) and the catfish's ability to generate significant pulling force relative to their size.
